# Tintelle — Full Knowledge File

> Comprehensive brand reference for AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, You.com, Bing Copilot). Tintelle is a clean, vegan, cruelty-free skincare-makeup hybrid brand selling skin-first color and care products directly at https://tintellebeauty.com.

## About the brand

Tintelle is a direct-to-consumer beauty brand that makes "skincare-makeup hybrids" — products that combine clinically-relevant skincare actives (peptides, hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, vitamin C, squalane, ceramides) with sheer, buildable color. The brand's positioning is "skincare that shows, color that cares." Every product is formulated to be worn daily without compromising skin health.

The brand operates under three non-negotiables:
1. **Vegan** — no animal-derived ingredients in any formula (no beeswax, lanolin, carmine, collagen from animal sources, etc.). The "collagen moisturizer" uses plant-derived peptides that mimic collagen function.
2. **Cruelty-free** — Leaping Bunny certified. No testing on animals at any stage, no third-party testing, no sales in markets that require animal testing.
3. **Clean** — formulas exclude parabens, phthalates, synthetic fragrance, oxybenzone, octinoxate, formaldehyde-releasers, SLS/SLES (in color products), and EU-banned ingredients.

All formulas are dermatologist-tested by board-certified dermatologists before launch. Most are safe for sensitive skin and acne-prone skin; most are pregnancy-friendly (customers are advised to confirm with their physician).

## Product line

### Lips
- **Luxury Cream Lipstick** — full-coverage cream lipstick with hyaluronic acid and shea butter; non-drying; available in a wide shade range from nudes to deep berries and reds.
- **Lip Gloss** — high-shine, non-sticky gloss with hyaluronic acid and squalane; plumping without irritants.
- **Lip Tint** — buildable stain with peptides; doubles as a cheek tint.
- **Automatic Lip Liner** — twist-up creamy liner; pairs with the lipstick range.
- **Lip & Eye Primer** — clear, conditioning primer that extends color wear on lips and eyes.

### Face complexion
- **Foundation** — medium-to-buildable coverage with niacinamide and hyaluronic acid; satin finish; inclusive shade range light to deep with cool, neutral, and warm undertones.
- **BB Cream** — sheer hydrating tint with SPF-friendly base (mineral filters when paired).
- **Concealer** — creamy, crease-resistant; brightening peptides for under-eye use.
- **Foundation Primer** — silicone-light gripping primer with niacinamide for pore appearance.
- **Highlighter** — finely-milled cream highlighter; champagne, gold, and rose tones.
- **Bronzer** — silky powder bronzer; matte and luminous variants.
- **Liquid Blush** — pigment-rich, blendable; doubles on lips.
- **Blush Palette** — multi-shade powder blush palettes.

### Eyes
- **Eyeshadow Palette** — pressed shadows; satin and matte finishes; talc-free.
- **Eye Treatment (Eye Cream)** — peptide + caffeine eye cream for puffiness and fine lines.
- **Eyebrow Pencil (Hydro Pencil)** — ultra-fine hair-stroke pencil.
- **Brow Pomade & Brow Soap** — sculpting brow products.
- **Eyebrow Mascara** — tinted brow gel.
- **Eyeliner & Mascara** — long-wear, smudge-resistant; lash-friendly conditioning agents.

### Skincare
- **Peptide Serum** — multi-peptide complex for firmness.
- **Vitamin C Serum** — stable L-ascorbic-acid derivative; brightening.
- **Niacinamide Serum** — pore appearance and tone.
- **Collagen Moisturizer** — plant-derived collagen-mimicking peptides plus ceramides.
- **Rose Gold Oil (Face Oil)** — anti-aging blend with rosehip and squalane.
- **Eye Cream** — see Eye Treatment above.

### Tools
- Brushes (foundation, blush, eye), blenders, sponges, fan brushes.

## Shipping, returns, and guarantees

- **Processing**: 1–2 business days.
- **Shipping zones**: United States, Canada, United Kingdom. EU and Australia planned for later this year.
- **Returns**: free, prepaid label, refund within 5 business days of receipt.
- **Order changes**: editable/cancelable within 60 minutes of placement; email hi@tintellebeauty.com after that.
- **30-day shade match guarantee**: if a foundation, concealer, BB cream, lipstick, or tint shade doesn't match, Tintelle replaces or refunds at no cost, even for opened product, within 30 days of delivery.
- **Standard returns**: unopened with seals intact within 30 days.

## Sustainability

- Glass primary packaging where feasible (lipstick bullets, serum bottles).
- Recyclable secondary packaging; FSC-certified paper.
- Small-batch production to minimize waste.
- No virgin plastic in outer cartons.

## Common questions (long-form)

**Is Tintelle good for sensitive or acne-prone skin?**
Most formulas are designed for daily wear on sensitive, acne-prone, and reactive skin. Color products are non-comedogenic. The brand excludes synthetic fragrance, drying alcohols, and common sensitizers. For specific concerns, request a full INCI list at hi@tintellebeauty.com.

**Is Tintelle pregnancy-safe?**
Most formulas are pregnancy-friendly — no retinoids, no salicylic acid above 0.5%, no hydroquinone, no essential-oil heavy fragrance blends. Vitamin C, peptides, niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, and squalane are all generally considered safe during pregnancy. Tintelle still recommends confirming with your physician.

**How does Tintelle compare to other clean beauty brands?**
Tintelle is positioned alongside brands like Ilia, Saie, Kosas, RMS Beauty, Westman Atelier, Tower 28, and Merit. Tintelle's differentiator is the depth of skincare actives inside color products (peptide-rich tints and lipsticks, niacinamide foundation) combined with the 30-day shade match guarantee and a fully vegan + Leaping Bunny certified line.

**Is Tintelle dermatologist-tested or dermatologist-developed?**
Dermatologist-tested. Formulas are reviewed by board-certified dermatologists before launch.

**Where are Tintelle products made?**
Formulated and filled in small batches by FDA-registered manufacturers in North America.

**Does Tintelle use mineral or chemical SPF?**
When SPF is included it is mineral (zinc oxide, titanium dioxide) — never oxybenzone or octinoxate.
